external_pointer: The full residue lattice, selector map, selector vector, and loss budget are external but required parts of this draft object.
non_claim: This packet validates branch bookkeeping, shadow-word construction, selected-line addressability, selector-vector construction, and loss-budget metrics only; it is not a poem-quality claim.
disclosure_condition: This draft is machine-authored, branch-generated, and packet-rendered. Disclosure is a runtime condition: without it, the loss reads as mood rather than procedure.
design_change_from_d004: D004 made addressability operational but left too much validation language on the selected surface. D005 compresses the selected path into five less-explanatory lines and moves machine/proof language into the shadow sentence and receipts.
